package rulefixtures

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
)

// scenario for validation_error_response_shape_inconsistent: Handlers in the same API module that emit different validation error contracts.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.
func scenario216CreateUser(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	var input struct{ Name string }
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&input); err != nil || input.Name == "" {
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		w.WriteHeader(http.StatusBadRequest)
		json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]string{"error": "name is required"})
		return
	}
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusCreated)
}

func scenario216UpdateUser(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	var input struct{ Email string }
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&input); err != nil || input.Email == "" {
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		w.WriteHeader(http.StatusBadRequest)
		json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{
			"errors": []map[string]string{{"field": "email", "msg": "email is required"}},
		})
		return
	}
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
}
